div.head: VIII Atr 17
div.ab: And Sunnondaga cypinga forbeode man georne be fullan worldwite.
And Sunnondaga cypinga forbeode man georne be fullan worldwite.
And Sunnondaga cypinga forbeode man georne be fullan worldwite.
And Sunday marketings shall be strictly forbidden, under pain of incurring the full civil penalty.
And Sunday markets are entirely prohibited, or suffer the full civil penalty.
Und Handelsgeschäfte an Sonntagen seien ernstlich bei voller staatlicher Strafe verboten.
And let Sunday trading be strictly forbidden, on pain of the full secular fine.

note.label: cites (implicitly)
note.quote: In 1014, as with tithes, came the introduction of a penalty for breach of the principle (4), and again this involved citation of Edgar, if not in this case explicitly.

div.note: suffer the full civil penalty: Wulfstan does not specify who would suffer in this instance, the market organizer or those participating in it.
